entry.title: ICON Leasing Fund Twelve, LLC: Entered riskiest 5%
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk entered the riskiest 5%: riskier than 97% of filers with the 10-K filed 2018-03-30 (was 78%).

entry.title: ICON Leasing Fund Twelve, LLC: Auditor change
entry.summary: Filed an 8-K under Item 4.01: change of auditor.

entry.title: ICON Leasing Fund Twelve, LLC: Risk jump
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk rose from riskier than 63% to 84% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2017-05-11.

entry.title: ICON Leasing Fund Twelve, LLC: Going-concern wording
